description: Save draft listing description, category, homepage or support URL via the signed-in Developer Dashboard, then reload to verify. Does not submit for review. Package title/summary, raw payloads, and icon uploads are unsupported.

category.description: Exact category label displayed by the dashboard

defaultLocale.description: Unsupported: change manifest default_locale and upload a new ZIP

headless.description: Run browser headless; use false for the first sign-in

homepageUrl.description: Homepage URL; empty string clears it

metadata.description: Unsupported: use the explicit dashboard fields

storeIconPath.description: Unsupported: upload the store icon directly in the dashboard

summary.description: Unsupported: change manifest description and upload a new ZIP

supportUrl.description: Support URL; empty string clears it

title.description: Unsupported: change manifest name and upload a new ZIP

name: update-metadata
